errors.claim: Management decided against including teletext support or voice recognition
errors.why_wrong: Management only ruled out teletext. Voice recognition was dropped in team discussion (UI designer and PM citing cost and lack of need), not by management.

errors.claim: Speaker 5 discussed ... novel features like potential LCD screens or sliding hatches
errors.why_wrong: The LCD screen was raised by the marketing expert (Speaker 3), and the sliding/pull-out idea originated with the marketing expert; Speaker 5's presentation did not mention these.

errors.claim: Unresolved Questions: Would adding a "find my remote" beep function fit within budget?
